ev.q: arthritis affected 57.4% of adults with HD, compared with 27.4% of adults in the general population
Prevalence of physical inactivity was lowest among adults without arthritis or HD
Average annual adult prevalence was 6.5% for HD and 26.9% for arthritis.
those with doctor-diagnosed arthritis were 60% more likely to be physically inactive
when adjusted for age, sex, race/ethnicity, education level, and BMI, they were 30% more likely to be inactive
BRFSS is a state-based, random-digit--dialed telephone survey

methods_quotes.q: data were combined across states, in unadjusted and adjusted (by age, sex, race/ethnicity, education level, and BMI) logistic regression models.
Statistical significance was determined by the chi-square test (p<0.05).
an annual average weighting was applied to account for multistage probability sampling.
All other estimates in this report are unadjusted.
